mappings.markingFocus: Find u = d/t₁ and v = d/t₂, then a = (v − u)/travel time.
mappings.examTrap: Do not treat the beam-blocking time as the journey time between gates.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Calculate each separation as mean velocity × time between gates.
mappings.examTrap: Longer travel time alone cannot prove the distance is greater.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Subtract the two circular areas, then multiply by thickness. Convert cm³ to m³.
mappings.examTrap: Do not subtract diameters before squaring, or treat cm³ as cm.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Use charge Q = IΔt, then N = Q/e, converting milli and nano first.
mappings.examTrap: Current is not the same as charge; do not forget the pulse duration.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Add the absolute uncertainties of both readings for a difference.
mappings.examTrap: The uncertainty is not automatically just one division; both ends matter.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Sum the absolute uncertainties (4 mm) and divide by total length (700 mm).
mappings.examTrap: Do not average the separate percentage uncertainties.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Calculate R=V/I using the values at that point, not a tangent gradient.
mappings.examTrap: The tangent gradient on a nonlinear I–V graph is not the required V/I here.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Convert MeV to J, then use p = E/c.
mappings.examTrap: Do not use p = mv for a photon or forget the mega factor.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: For subtraction, add the absolute uncertainties of the two measurements.
mappings.examTrap: Subtracting readings does not mean subtracting their uncertainties.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Add the percentage uncertainties: (0.1/12 + 0.1/8) × 100.
mappings.examTrap: Do not add 0.1 mm directly to a dimensionless ratio.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Draw the least steep straight line consistent with the full error-bar range.
mappings.examTrap: On a negative-gradient plot, 'minimum magnitude' means closest to zero.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.skill: EMF from a V–I data point
mappings.markingFocus: Use V = ε − Ir, so ε = V + Ir.
mappings.examTrap: Lost volts are added back to terminal voltage, not subtracted.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Add endpoint uncertainties to ±0.6 cm, then divide by 48.0 cm.
mappings.examTrap: Do not use ±0.3 cm for the separation; it uses two readings.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.skill: Eight node intervals to microwave frequency
mappings.markingFocus: Adjacent nodes are λ/2 apart: λ=2×0.48/8; then f=v/λ.
mappings.examTrap: Do not treat the full 0.48 m as one wavelength or eight whole wavelengths.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Each stretched half is √(1.50²+0.12²) m; double, then subtract 3.00 m.
mappings.examTrap: The 0.12 m vertical movement is not the wire extension.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.skill: Friction holding a block on an incline
mappings.markingFocus: With no sliding, friction balances mg sin(25°), directed uphill.
mappings.examTrap: Friction is parallel to the slope; normal force is perpendicular.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Each alpha emission reduces nucleon number by four; beta emission leaves A unchanged.
mappings.examTrap: Do not use the change in proton number to count alpha decays here.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.skill: Base units of Young modulus and stress
mappings.markingFocus: Both equal force per area (N m⁻²); reduce newtons to base units.
mappings.examTrap: Energy has units kg m² s⁻², while force is kg m s⁻².
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.markingFocus: Compare 10⁻¹², 10⁻⁹, 10⁻⁶, 10⁻³.
mappings.examTrap: Micro is 10⁻⁶, not 10⁻³. Milli is larger than micro.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.

mappings.examTrap: Adding electrons gives negative charge; divide by the whole ion mass.
mappings.provenance: New question and numbers; AQA paper/mark scheme used to verify method family, not wording.
